A two bedroom flat (fully furnished) is available in a well located west end development near the White City/Wood Lane station close to the Hammersmith Hospital. This is a sunny flat (with a balcony), fully furnished with a fully loaded kitchen, dishwasher, washing machine and microwave. The Landlord has recently re-done it so has brand new floorings, kitchen and appliances. Amenities close – The flat is ideally located within minutes’ walk to the popular Television Center/White City Place where you have access to a variety of restaurants, Westfield Shopping Center and fitness studios. Tesco is located within a 5 mins walk. Rent - £2189 for a month (for both rooms and full flat). This does not include utilities (like council tax, Water, Gas, Electricity). Availability from – 20 May 2026 (flexible). This flat is perfect for 2 individuals who want to share a flat, or a family who want easy access to what White City has to offer and still want to experience London. With 2 Tube Stations (White City and Wood Lane) and Shepherds Bush within close proximity the location is perfect for city workers, students and Hospital employees. Please contact if interested in a viewing. Kindly no agents or third parties please!
